faq.q: Does Titanium Landing Gear Side Brace meet AMS specifications?
faq.a: Titanium Landing Gear Side Brace is manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V per AMS 4928 (bar/rod) or AMS 4911 (sheet/plate) with mechanical property verification at room and elevated temperature. Heat treatment per AMS 2801 (solution treat 925-980°C + age 510-540°C) provides STA condition properties. All processing is documented per AS9102 FAI requirements for landing gear folding.
